Great atmosphere and ambiance in a busy place. The concept is good and they have kept to the expectations. …

Really enjoyed my visit to Tea Villa Café. The peri peri pesto rice bowl and Aglio Olio pasta were both excellent. Kudos to Chef Saikat for the delicious food, and Sukanta for the warm and attentive service. The ambience is cozy and perfect for a relaxed meal. Looking forward to visiting again!
